verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration processes applicants' personal data, so whether that data can be kept out of AI training is a fair privacy-posture question for this kind of service. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out or policy. The only related item is a way to see the personal information UKVI holds, which is a different control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
